PLACEHOLDER — This privacy policy will be replaced before release.

AI Food Enhancer ("the App") respects your privacy. This policy describes how we collect, use, and protect your information.

1. DATA COLLECTION
The App processes images entirely on your device using on-device AI models. No images are transmitted to external servers. We do not collect, store, or share your photos.

2. CAMERA AND STORAGE
The App requires camera access to capture food photos and storage access to save enhanced images to your gallery. These permissions are used solely for the stated purposes.

3. ANALYTICS
We may collect anonymous usage statistics (such as feature usage counts) to improve the App. No personally identifiable information is collected.

4. THIRD-PARTY SERVICES
The App uses TensorFlow Lite for on-device image processing. No data is sent to Google or TensorFlow servers.

5. DATA RETENTION
Enhanced images are stored locally on your device. Processing history is kept in a local database and can be cleared at any time.

6. CHANGES
We may update this policy from time to time. Changes will be posted within the App.

7. CONTACT
For questions about this privacy policy, contact us at privacy@foodenhancer.com.
